# Overpass

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

OpenStreetMap features an Overpass QL query finds, as a table of features: tagged nodes as points, ways as lines or polygons, multipolygon relations. `{{bbox}}` in the query is the bounds as south,west,north,east. The engine fetches once per query; edit it to fetch again.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "overpass", "name": "overpass", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:west`, or read elsewhere as `ch('overpass/west')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
This operator has no input ports.
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
